reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks is **#8841**.

That number comes from Tobias's own message in #central-random on Oct 13. He wrote that Door 2 still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He's a member of that channel, and so is everyone in this one.

I didn't use the "OPS-7485" guess he sent me privately. It was a guess, not the real ticket number, and he asked me to keep it to myself.
